app_fee.value: The Graduate Division application fee is $100 for all applicants, and it is non-refundable.
app_fee.quote: Application fee is $100 for all applicants

fee_waiver.value: The Graduate Division pages checked do not mention an application fee waiver.

gre_general.value: Each graduate program sets its own GRE rule; see the program record.
gre_general.quote: Many graduate programs require or recommend applicants to take standardized exams

toefl_min.value: The Graduate Division minimum is an overall 3.5 on the new TOEFL iBT; programs may set higher.
toefl_min.quote: Overall score of 3.5 TOEFL iBT (scores may vary for each graduate program)

ielts_min.value: The Graduate Division minimum is an overall IELTS Academic band of 5.5.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS Academic (International English Language Testing System) | Overall score of 5.5

english_waiver.value: India is not on the Graduate Division's list of English-exempt countries, so an English-medium degree from India does not waive the test.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants are exempt from the English proficiency exams if they are native speakers of English or have received within the last five years a bachelor's degree or advanced degree from an accredited/recognized college or university in the English Language Proficiency Exempt Countries

notes: GRE conflict: the documentation-requirements page says 'All other applicants submit GRE General Test scores', but the standardized-exams page limits required exams to non-traditional grades and English tests, so the university GRE value is Not stated. No Graduate Division fee-waiver rule was found. Epidemiology and Public Health PhDs have no matching STEM field and are not saved.
